# Form builder: interactive document forms and questionnaires with docassemble

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' form builder for creating interactive document forms with docassemble, the guided-interview platform that assembles documents from user answers. Describe the form you need and the skill drafts the docassemble interview YAML: interview structure, conditional question branching (business vs individual paths, matter-type routing), a full field-type catalog (text, email, integer, currency, date, yes/no, multiple choice, checkboxes, file upload), and generated document attachments (e.g. a service agreement rendered from the collected answers). Includes a worked client-intake example and links to the official docassemble docs. Honest caveats: it's a YAML authoring guide, not a docassemble runtime — you still need a docassemble server to run the interviews; the example domain skews legal (client intake, contracts). MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
